stories.headline: Alibaba Releases Qwen3.6-27B, a Dense Model That Outperforms Its Own 397B MoE on Coding Benchmarks

key_facts.fact: Qwen3.6-27B is a 27-billion-parameter dense open-weight model under Apache 2.0 license, the first dense variant in the Qwen 3.6 family.
key_facts.excerpt: Alibaba's Qwen Team has released Qwen3.6-27B, the first dense open-weight model in the Qwen3.6 family — and arguably the most capable 27-billion-parameter model available today for coding agents.

key_facts.fact: On SWE-bench Verified the model scores 77.2%, surpassing the much larger Qwen3.5-397B-A17B MoE (which scored lower) and approaching Claude 4.5 Opus's 80.9%.
key_facts.excerpt: SWE-bench Verified scores 77.2, up from 75.0, and competitive with Claude 4.5 Opus's 80.9.

key_facts.fact: On Terminal-Bench 2.0, Qwen3.6-27B scores 59.3, matching Claude 4.5 Opus exactly and far exceeding the 35B MoE sibling's 51.5.
key_facts.excerpt: Terminal-Bench 2.0, evaluated under a 3-hour timeout with 32 CPUs and 48 GB RAM, reaches 59.3 — matching Claude 4.5 Opus exactly, and outperforming Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (51.5).

key_facts.fact: The model uses a hybrid architecture blending Gated DeltaNet linear attention with traditional self-attention, supporting 262K native context (extendable to 1M tokens via YaRN).
key_facts.excerpt: Native context is 262,144 tokens; YaRN scaling is advertised up to 1,010,000 tokens for experimental long-document jobs.

key_facts.fact: It introduces a Thinking Preservation mechanism that keeps prior chain-of-thought across turns so the model doesn't re-derive scratch work each tool round.
key_facts.excerpt: For multi-turn agents, the release introduces thinking preservation—an API/template flag that keeps earlier chain-of-thought blocks in the visible history.

key_facts.fact: On reasoning benchmarks GPQA Diamond reaches 87.8, AIME 2026 hits 94.1, and LiveCodeBench v6 scores 83.9.
key_facts.excerpt: On reasoning benchmarks, GPQA Diamond reaches 87.8 (up from 85.5), AIME26 hits 94.1 (up from 92.6), and LiveCodeBench v6 scores 83.9 (up from 80.7).

stories.headline: China's 360 Digital Security Uses AI Agent to Discover ~1,000 Unknown Software Vulnerabilities

key_facts.fact: 360 Digital Security Group developed an AI-powered 'Vulnerability Discovery Agent' that uncovered approximately 1,000 previously unknown vulnerabilities, including in Microsoft Office and OpenClaw.
key_facts.excerpt: Chinese cybersecurity firm 360 Digital Security Group has used an artificial intelligence agent to uncover approximately 1,000 previously unknown software vulnerabilities, including critical flaws embedded deep within Microsoft Office applications.

key_facts.fact: The AI agent used a combination of LLM reasoning, symbolic execution, and reinforcement learning to explore software behavior, finding flaws in memory handling, input validation, and privilege escalation over a six-month testing window.
key_facts.excerpt: 360's AI agent used a combination of large language model (LLM) reasoning, symbolic execution, and reinforcement learning to explore software behavior at machine speed.

key_facts.fact: The findings were detailed in a report by Natto Thoughts, a research group focused on Chinese cybersecurity, positioning 360 as a competitor to Anthropic's Mythos in AI-driven vulnerability discovery.
key_facts.excerpt: A large Chinese cybersecurity firm is using artificial intelligence to identify security vulnerabilities in widely used software applications, positioning itself as a competitor to Anthropic.

key_facts.fact: 360 says the agent operates under strict ethical constraints: no live exploitation, no data exfiltration, and testing conducted in isolated, air-gapped environments.
key_facts.excerpt: The company emphasizes that its AI agent operates under strict ethical constraints, including no live exploitation, no data exfiltration, and testing conducted in isolated, air-gapped environments.

key_facts.fact: The system reduces vulnerability detection time from weeks to hours, operating continuously and autonomously unlike traditional penetration testing.
key_facts.excerpt: This AI-driven approach operates continuously and autonomously, reducing detection time from weeks to hours.

stories.headline: FDA Approves Denali's Avlayah, First Biologic Designed to Cross Blood-Brain Barrier, for Hunter Syndrome

key_facts.fact: The FDA granted accelerated approval for Avlayah (tividenofusp alfa-eknm), the first FDA-approved biologic specifically designed to cross the blood-brain barrier, for treatment of neurologic manifestations of Hunter syndrome (MPS II).
key_facts.excerpt: Denali Therapeutics Inc. announced the FDA has granted accelerated approval for Avlayah (tividenofusp alfa-eknm), the first FDA-approved biologic specifically designed to cross the blood-brain barrier and reach the whole body, including the brain.

key_facts.fact: In the Phase I/II clinical trial, Avlayah demonstrated a 91% reduction in cerebrospinal fluid heparan sulfate (CSF HS) levels from baseline by week 24; 93% of patients (41 of 44) had CSF HS levels within the range of individuals without Hunter syndrome.
key_facts.excerpt: In a Phase I/II clinical trial, Avlayah demonstrated a 91% (95% CI: 89%, 92%) reduction in CSF HS levels from baseline by week 24 of treatment. At week 24, 93% (41 of 44) of Avlayah-treated patients had CSF HS levels within the range of individuals without Hunter syndrome.

key_facts.fact: The approval validates Denali's TransportVehicle platform for delivering biologic medicines across the blood-brain barrier, potentially applicable to a wide range of neurodegenerative diseases and lysosomal storage disorders.
key_facts.excerpt: 'This milestone validates our TransportVehicle platform and its potential to overcome the long-standing challenge of delivering biologic medicines across the blood-brain barrier, with the aim to transform the treatment of a wide range of neurodegenerative diseases, lysosomal storage disorders and other serious diseases.'

key_facts.fact: Hunter syndrome affects approximately 1 in 100,000 to 170,000 male births; existing therapies like Elaprase cannot reach the brain. Avlayah is the first therapeutic innovation for the community in nearly 20 years.
key_facts.excerpt: 'The FDA approval of Avlayah represents a breakthrough advance as the first therapeutic innovation for the Hunter syndrome community in nearly 20 years.'

key_facts.fact: Continued approval may be contingent upon verification of clinical benefit in the Phase II/III COMPASS confirmatory trial, currently enrolling participants in North America, South America, and Europe.
key_facts.excerpt: Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial.

stories.headline: EU Launches AccelerateEU Strategy to Slash Fossil Fuel Dependence After €24B Iran War Energy Shock

key_facts.fact: The European Commission launched AccelerateEU, a new strategy to reduce fossil fuel dependence and shield the bloc from energy price shocks; the EU has spent an additional €24 billion on energy imports since the Iran war escalation without receiving any extra energy.
key_facts.excerpt: 'Since the escalation of the conflict in the Middle East, the EU has spent an additional €24 billion on energy imports due to higher prices – without receiving a single extra molecule of energy,' the European Commission said.

key_facts.fact: The Commission will avoid major market interventions like gas price caps or windfall taxes for now; instead it plans to curb EU tax rules to favour electricity over oil and gas, and make it easier for governments to cut industrial electricity taxes to zero.
key_facts.excerpt: Draft proposals seen by Reuters show the EU will, for now, avoid major market interventions such as capping gas prices or taxing energy companies' windfall profits. Instead, the Commission plans to curb EU tax rules to favour electricity over oil and gas.

key_facts.fact: EU energy commissioner Dan Jørgensen warned the disruption is costing Europe around €500 million per day; the Commission will present an Electrification Action Plan by summer with a binding electrification target.
key_facts.excerpt: Crucially, the Commission will present legislative proposals on network charges and taxation in May, so electricity is taxed less than gas. Next to that, the Commission will present an Electrification Action Plan by the Summer which will include an electrification target.

key_facts.fact: The EU produced 71% of its electricity from low-carbon sources (renewables + nuclear) in 2025, up from ~60% in 2022, which analysts say makes the electricity price shock smaller than in 2022 despite the oil shock potentially being worse.
key_facts.excerpt: The EU produced 71% of its electricity from low-carbon sources, including renewables and nuclear, last year, up from around 60% in 2022, data from think tank Ember showed.

key_facts.fact: Von der Leyen said: 'We must accelerate the shift to homegrown, clean energies. This will give us energy independence and security, and mean we are better able to weather geopolitical storms.'
key_facts.excerpt: 'We must accelerate the shift to homegrown, clean energies. This will give us energy independence and security and mean we are better able to weather geopolitical storms.'

stories.headline: Germany Unveils First-Ever Military Strategy, Aims to Be Europe's Strongest Conventional Army by 2029

key_facts.fact: Germany's Chief of Defence General Carsten Breuer signed the Bundeswehr's first Military Strategy on April 22, forming the Overall Concept for Military Defence; the full document is classified.
key_facts.excerpt: General Carsten Breuer, the Bundeswehr's Chief of Defence, today signed Germany's first Military Strategy (Militärstrategie der Bundeswehr).

key_facts.fact: The strategy targets 460,000 total soldiers (260,000 active, 200,000 reserve) by mid-2030s, with an interim milestone of 204,000 active soldiers by 2029, up from ~186,000 today.
key_facts.excerpt: German Defence Minister Boris Pistorius said Berlin aimed for a military of 460,000 soldiers, a target set in 2025 that includes 200,000 reservists.

key_facts.fact: Russia is identified as the 'greatest and most direct threat' to German and transatlantic security; the strategy states 'Russia is creating the conditions for a military attack on NATO countries.'
key_facts.excerpt: In military strategy, Russia is considered for the foreseeable future to be the 'greatest and most direct threat' to German and transatlantic security.

key_facts.fact: Priority capabilities include air defence, long-range precision strikes across all domains, territorial missile defence, and AI integration; the strategy introduces a 'One-Theatre-Approach' connecting domains.
key_facts.excerpt: Germany will develop the capability to conduct deep precision strikes across all domains and to provide territorial missile defence.

key_facts.fact: Defence Minister Pistorius said: 'Our ambition is and must be to be Europe's strongest conventional military,' noting that AI and automation will impact troop planning and qualifications.
key_facts.excerpt: 'It is clear that automation and artificial intelligence will continue to impact our planning, how many troops we will need and with what qualifications,' he noted. 'Our ambition is and must be...to be Europe's strongest conventional military.'

stories.headline: Iran Fires on 3 Ships in Strait of Hormuz and Seizes 2 as US Blockade and Ceasefire Both Continue

key_facts.fact: Iran's Revolutionary Guard fired on three commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz on April 22 and seized two of them (MSC Francesca and Epaminondas), intensifying its assault on shipping in the waterway.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran fired on three ships in the Strait of Hormuz and seized two of them Wednesday, intensifying its assault on shipping in the key waterway.

key_facts.fact: The attacks came hours after Trump extended the ceasefire while maintaining the US naval blockade; Treasury Secretary Bessent said Kharg Island storage will soon be full and Iranian oil wells will be shut in.
key_facts.excerpt: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent wrote on social media that under Trump's orders, the U.S. Navy will continue the blockade of Iran's ports. 'In a matter of days, Kharg Island storage will be full and the fragile Iranian oil wells will be shut in.'

key_facts.fact: Brent crude briefly surpassed $100/barrel, a 35% increase from prewar levels; the standoff has choked off nearly all exports through the strait where 20% of the world's traded oil passes in peacetime.
key_facts.excerpt: International benchmark Brent crude futures with June delivery traded 0.5% higher at $99.03 per barrel, paring gains after briefly surpassing $100.

key_facts.fact: Iran refused to send a delegation to a second round of peace talks in Pakistan; its chief negotiator said a ceasefire 'only makes sense' if not violated by the US blockade.
key_facts.excerpt: Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf, Iran's parliament speaker who met with U.S. Vice President JD Vance in Pakistan earlier this month, said a complete ceasefire 'only makes sense' if it is not violated by the U.S. blockade of Iranian ports.

key_facts.fact: The US has turned back 31 vessels since its blockade began on April 13; there have been more than 30 attacks on ships in the Mideast since the war started February 28.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. has turned back 31 vessels since its blockade began, U.S. Central Command said Thursday.

key_facts.fact: Panama condemned the 'illegal seizure' of the Panama-flagged MSC Francesca, calling it a serious attack on maritime security; the White House said seizures didn't violate ceasefire terms.
key_facts.excerpt: Panama condemned what it called the 'illegal seizure' of the Panama-flagged MSC Francesca, and said it represented a serious attack on maritime security.

stories.headline: Lutnick Says No Nvidia H200 Chips Sold to China Yet, Beijing Hasn't Approved Purchases

key_facts.fact: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick told the Senate Appropriations Committee that Nvidia's H200 chips have not yet been sold to Chinese companies.
key_facts.excerpt: Howard Lutnick, the US Secretary of Commerce, stated that the advanced artificial intelligence (AI) chip, the H200, has not yet been sold to Chinese companies.

key_facts.fact: Lutnick said the Chinese government has not approved the purchases, citing Beijing's focus on investing in its domestic semiconductor industry.
key_facts.excerpt: Le gouvernement central chinois ne les a pas encore autorisés à acheter les puces, parce qu'il essaie de concentrer son investissement sur sa propre industrie nationale.

key_facts.fact: The Trump administration approved H200 exports to China after the US-China summit in October, but deliveries have been stalled by disagreements on conditions on both sides.
key_facts.excerpt: En janvier, l'administration Trump a donné son feu vert officiel aux ventes de puces H200... Mais les livraisons de puces ont été entravées par des désaccords sur les conditions de vente.

key_facts.fact: Lutnick emphasized 'The United States will not sell its best semiconductors to China under any circumstances,' noting Blackwell chips are not being sold at all.
key_facts.excerpt: Lutnik emphasised... 'the United States will not sell its best semiconductors to China under any circumstances'. The H200 chip is based on the Hopper architecture and its performance is about six times higher than the H20 chip.

key_facts.fact: Lutnick also appeared to back away from reimposing the 'affiliates rule' restricting tech exports to thousands of Chinese companies, saying it's part of the broader trade deal balance.
key_facts.excerpt: "Je suis d'accord pour dire que la règle des affiliés est une chose intelligente que les États-Unis d'Amérique devraient envisager, mais elle fait partie de l'équilibre de cet accord commercial complet."

stories.headline: OpenAI Releases Privacy Filter, an Open-Weight Model for PII Detection With 1.5B Parameters

key_facts.fact: Privacy Filter is an open-weight model with 1.5 billion total parameters and 50 million active parameters, released under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face and GitHub.
key_facts.excerpt: With 1.5 billion total parameters and 50 million active parameters, Privacy Filter identifies private names, addresses, email addresses, phone numbers, URLs, dates, account numbers, passwords, API keys, and other sensitive information.

key_facts.fact: The model processes up to 128,000 tokens in a single forward pass and is small enough to run on a standard laptop or in a web browser.
key_facts.excerpt: By providing a 1.5-billion-parameter model that can run on a standard laptop or directly in a web browser, the company is effectively handing developers a 'privacy-by-design' toolkit.

key_facts.fact: It uses a sparse MoE bidirectional token-classification architecture (described as a 'Mixture of BERTs') derived from the gpt-oss family.
key_facts.excerpt: Architecturally, Privacy Filter is a derivative of OpenAI's gpt-oss family, a series of open-weight reasoning models.

key_facts.fact: The model scored 96% on the PII-Masking-300k benchmark out of the box, rising to 97.43% with a corrected version of the test.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI reports its model scored 96% on a standard benchmark using the PII-Masking-300k dataset out of the box, with a corrected version of the same test pushing it to 97.43%.

key_facts.fact: It detects eight PII categories: names, addresses, emails, phone numbers, URLs, dates, account numbers, and secrets like passwords and API keys.
key_facts.excerpt: Privacy Filter scans for eight categories of personal information: names, addresses, emails, phone numbers, URLs, dates, account numbers, and secrets like passwords and API keys.

stories.headline: Samsung Union Rally Draws 30,000+ Workers Demanding 15% of AI Chip Profits, Threatens 18-Day Strike

key_facts.fact: Police estimated 30,000 attendees (organizers said 39,000-40,000) at the rally outside Samsung's Pyeongtaek semiconductor complex — the largest union rally in Samsung's history.
key_facts.excerpt: Police told local media about 30,000 people attended the rally in South Korea's southern city of Pyeongtaek, home to Samsung's sprawling semiconductor complex, while organizers put the number at 39,000.

key_facts.fact: The union demands 15% of operating profit be allocated to chip-division employees; the total would exceed 40 trillion won ($27B), or more than $400,000 per worker on average.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung's labor union wants 15% of operating profit handed to chip-division employees. The figure — more than 40 trillion won ($27 billion) — could mean more than $400,000 per worker on average.

key_facts.fact: Workers threaten an 18-day general strike starting May 21 if demands are not met; this could delay chip deliveries to customers and further push up memory prices.
key_facts.excerpt: Si leurs revendications ne sont pas satisfaites, ils prévoient de faire grève pendant 18 jours à partir du 21 mai.

key_facts.fact: The core grievance is a massive bonus gap with rival SK Hynix: a Samsung chip worker with a ₩76M base salary reportedly received ₩38M in bonuses for 2025, less than one-third what an SK Hynix employee with similar pay would get.
key_facts.excerpt: Le syndicat des travailleurs de Samsung Electronics affirme qu'un employé de la division des puces, dont le salaire de base est de 76 millions de wons, recevrait 38 millions de wons de prime pour 2025, soit moins d'un tiers du montant auquel un employé de SK Hynix bénéficiant d'un salaire similaire pourrait prétendre.

key_facts.fact: Union membership has surged past 90,000, representing over 70% of Samsung's South Korean workforce; management proposed 10% of operating profit for performance pay and a 6.2% wage increase but rejected abolishing the bonus cap.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics says it has proposed a compensation package to the union that includes a 6.2% wage increase, special compensation and expanded benefits...maintaining a negative position on the union's demand to abolish the cap on performance bonuses.

stories.headline: 37,000 Samsung Workers Rally at Pyeongtaek Chip Campus, Threaten 18-Day Strike Over Bonus Demands

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics' labor union rallied up to 37,000-40,000 workers at the Pyeongtaek semiconductor campus on April 23, the union's largest show of force to date.
key_facts.excerpt: Thousands of Samsung Electronics workers rallied Thursday at its computer chip complex in Pyeongtaek... Union officials said about 40,000 members participated in the protest.

key_facts.fact: The union demands 15% of annual operating profit as performance bonuses with no cap. With Samsung's projected full-year operating profit at ~306 trillion won, that implies a ~45 trillion won payout.
key_facts.excerpt: The union is demanding 15 percent of annual operating profit as performance bonuses without a cap.

key_facts.fact: The union has threatened an 18-day walkout from May 21 through June 7 if negotiations fail, which it claims would cost Samsung more than 1 trillion won ($676M) per day.
key_facts.excerpt: The union has threatened to stage an 18-day walkout starting May 21 if negotiations with management fail and claims that such action would cost the company more than 1 trillion won ($676 million) a day.

stories.headline: SK Hynix Posts Record Q1: Revenue Tops 50T Won for First Time, 72% Operating Margin Surpasses Nvidia

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix reported Q1 operating profit of 37.61 trillion won ($27.8B), five times higher than a year earlier, and record revenue of 52.58 trillion won ($38.9B), up 198% YoY — the first time quarterly revenue surpassed 50 trillion won.
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue also hit a record 52.58 trillion won ($38.9 billion), up 198 percent from the same period a year earlier. It is the first time SK hynix's quarterly revenue has surpassed 50 trillion won.

key_facts.fact: Operating margin reached 72%, surpassing Nvidia's semiconductor industry peak of 65% (Q4 2025) and TSMC's 58.1% (Q1 2026), an unprecedented level for an asset-heavy memory manufacturer.
key_facts.excerpt: SK Hynix's 72% operating margin not only exceeded the semiconductor industry peak of 65% set by Nvidia in the fourth quarter of 2025, but also significantly outperformed TSMC's 58.1% operating margin in the first quarter of 2026.

key_facts.fact: The average price of DRAM used in HBM jumped to $13/unit at end of Q1, ten times the $1.35 of a year earlier; SK Hynix held a 57% share of the HBM market.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung managed to reclaim the top spot in DRAM revenue in the last three months of 2025, according to data from Counterpoint Research, though SK Hynix continued to dominate in HBM with a 57% market share.

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix said HBM demand will exceed its production capacity for the next three years; the company plans to ship HBM4E samples in H2 2026 and begin mass production in 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: 'HBM demand required over the next three years exceeds our production capacity,' SK hynix said.

key_facts.fact: SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won reportedly said in March that the global chip wafer shortage is likely to persist until 2030, with a projected shortfall exceeding 20%.

stories.headline: Tencent Releases Hy3-Preview, First Flagship AI Model Under Former OpenAI Researcher Yao Shunyu

key_facts.fact: Tencent released and open-sourced Hy3-preview (Hunyuan 3.0 Preview), a MoE language model with 295B total parameters, 21B activated parameters, and 256K max context length.
key_facts.excerpt: Hy3 preview is a MoE language model integrating fast and slow thinking, with 295 billion total parameters, 21 billion activated parameters, and support for a maximum context length of 256K.

key_facts.fact: The model is smaller than Tencent's previous flagship HY 2.0 (400B+ parameters), reflecting a focus on balancing performance and cost-effectiveness rather than pursuing massive scale.
key_facts.excerpt: The model is relatively small with only 295 billion parameters, bucking a recent trend of large models with trillions of parameters.

key_facts.fact: It is the first model since former OpenAI researcher Yao Shunyu joined Tencent as Chief AI Scientist; training began in late January 2026 and took less than three months.
key_facts.excerpt: Hy3 preview is not only the first large model after Hunyuan underwent a full-link reconstruction but also Yao Shunyu's first report card since joining Tencent as Chief AI Scientist.

key_facts.fact: On SWE-Bench coding benchmarks, Hy3-preview scored 74.4%, up from Hy2's 53.0%, a more than 40% improvement in coding capability.
key_facts.excerpt: Hy2在这个测试中只有53.0%的分数，Hy3 preview提升到了74.4%，编程能力猛增了40%以上

key_facts.fact: Tencent says agentic capabilities were one of the most significantly improved areas; the model has been deployed in Yuanbao, CodeBuddy, and other internal Tencent products.
key_facts.excerpt: Agentic capabilities were 'one of the most significantly improved areas in this release'... the model was already deployed in Tencent's flagship AI products including consumer app Yuanbao and coding assistant CodeBuddy.

key_facts.fact: Yao Shunyu stated Hy3-preview is the first step in reconstructing the Hunyuan large model, and a larger model is already in development.
key_facts.excerpt: Yao Shunyu stated that Hy3 preview is the first step in reconstructing the Hunyuan large model... under the support of new infrastructure and technical philosophy, Hunyuan's larger models are already on the way.

stories.headline: TSMC Unveils Roadmap Through 2029 With A12 and A13 Nodes, Skips ASML's High-NA EUV Through Decade

key_facts.fact: TSMC revealed A13 (1.3nm) and A12 (1.2nm) process nodes at its 2026 North American Technology Symposium, both targeted for production in 2029. A13 offers 6% area savings over A14 with full backward compatibility.
key_facts.excerpt: The A13 process is a direct shrink of TSMC's A14 node announced in 2025, which provides 6% area savings from A14. The A13 design rules are fully backward compatible with A14.

key_facts.fact: TSMC will not use ASML's high-NA EUV machines (costing €350M+ each) for any production nodes through 2029, choosing to maximize current EUV equipment instead.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC has no plans to buy ASML's most advanced litho tool – the $350 million high-NA EUV machine... 'We continue to be able to harvest the benefit from current EUV,' said Zhang.

key_facts.fact: TSMC is adopting a dual-track strategy: new client/mobile nodes every year, and AI/HPC nodes with backside power delivery every two years. A16 slipped to 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC is adopting a new strategy for process technology introductions, offering a new node for client applications every year and for heavy-duty AI and HPC applications every two years.

key_facts.fact: A 14-reticle size CoWoS package capable of integrating 10 large compute dies and 20 HBM stacks is slated for production in 2028, with beyond-14-reticle and 40-reticle SoW-X in 2029.
key_facts.excerpt: A 14-reticle size CoWoS, capable of integrating approximately 10 large compute dies and 20 HBM stacks, is slated for production in 2028.

key_facts.fact: TSMC SVP Kevin Zhang confirmed the company plans to open a CoWoS and 3D-IC advanced chip packaging plant in Arizona by 2029, with construction already underway.
key_facts.excerpt: "We are going to build a CoWoS capability and 3D-IC capability there before 2029, so that's still our goal," Zhang said.

key_facts.fact: The decision contrasts with Intel, which has installed ASML's High-NA EUV system and expects risk production in 2027, and Samsung, which received its first High-NA scanner in late 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel has already installed ASML's Twinscan EXE:5200B High-NA system and expects risk production in 2027 with volume output in 2028. Samsung received its first High-NA scanner in late 2025.
